liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Truckin'** (4 reviews): Reviewer calls the Truckin' into Eyes sequence fantastic, and notes the show is brief at two discs; Reviewer praises the Truckin' into Eyes pairing [6][7][13][15]
- **Slipknot!** (3 reviews): Reviewer says Slipknot! follows Eyes, calling it the first-ever appearance of the piece; Jerry leads the band through Slipknot!, developing the theme early, like the band learning on the fly [5][8][9]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls the Scarlet Begonias tasty; Reviewer says Scarlet Begonias is well done [9][12]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 review): Reviewer hears Jerry as all over the map on China Cat [15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Eyes playing electric and votes it their favorite version so far [5]

## The recordings

- **gd74-06-20.sbd.clugston.2179.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 143 min; rated 4.4/5 by 43 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the recording muddy compared with other 1974 shows on the site; Mix is bass heavy with great drums; Technical pops and snaps occur in the first few minutes of Truckin' [7][8][13]
- **gd1974-06-20.sbd.remaster.105427.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 139 min; rated 3/5 by 6 [2]. Said about its sound: Analysis says it lacks 4:14 of between-song tuning and has levels raised past maximum [2]
- **gd1974-06-20.sbd-set2.finney.211.shnf**: soundboard; 7 songs; 67 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer thinks the best Eyes came six days later in Providence, but this one ranks high [4]
- Reviewer considers the show somewhat short for 1974 but solid throughout [7]
- Reviewer ranks this Eyes highly, though the one in Kentucky two days earlier is tighter [8]
- Reviewer says the show is overlooked because of nearby dates like Freedom Hall, Des Moines and others [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd74-06-20.sbd.clugston.2179.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Master is a 7-inch two-track soundboard reel, then cassette, then DAT, then CDR; Scott Clugston uploaded it, sourced via 'the usual', first to abgd and later to etree [1]
- **gd1974-06-20.sbd.remaster.105427.flac16**: transferred by ChinaCat66; source: SBD > MR > Cassette > DAT > CD [2]. Also: This remaster is said to be a retracking of SHNID 2179 [2]
- **gd1974-06-20.sbd-set2.finney.211.shnf**: source: SBD > ? > CD [3]
